psychological_meaning: Jade is a color associated with tranquility, wisdom, and justice. It promotes feelings of love, nurture, and harmony. The color is also linked to good health and a renewed sense of purpose. It embodies balance and stability, fostering generosity and a deep connection with family.

real_world_examples.title: Jade Jewelry
real_world_examples.description: Jade is a precious stone often used in jewelry, symbolizing luck and prosperity.

real_world_examples.title: Lush Forests
